title: Split main.ts along its seams before it takes more
notes: src/main/main.ts is at exactly 600 code lines after #408 (the file-size limit), so the next change that wires a port into it cannot land. Split along its natural seams (for example the ports each feature hands its actions, window/app lifecycle, IPC registration) into files named for what they are; no behaviour change, no file named main-part2. Start after #406, #407 and #408 merge, since they all touch main.ts.
